name: Kaj
author: Leon San José Larsson
description: Docker containers in the Omarchy bar: live status, stats, logs, and controls.

barWidget.description: Docker containers with live stats, logs, and start/stop/restart controls.

schema.label: Read-only mode
schema.description: Show status, stats, and logs but disable every action that changes a container. Useful on machines where the Docker socket is shared or production-adjacent.

schema.label: Show CPU and memory
schema.description: Stream per-container resource usage. Turn off to leave one fewer long-running docker process attached to the daemon.

schema.label: Show the container count in the bar
schema.description: Show how many containers are running next to the icon. Turn off for the icon alone.

schema.label: Container status filter on open
schema.description: Which status filter is selected each time the panel opens. Problems covers unhealthy, crashed, OOM-killed, and restart-looping containers.

schema.label: Notify when a container exits
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a container exits non-zero or is killed for running out of memory.

schema.label: Reconcile interval (seconds)
schema.description: Kaj updates from the Docker event stream, so this is only a safety net that re-syncs if an event is ever missed.
